title: Post-correction cadence never advances past invitation_sent — co-nudge and reminders are mislabeled as invitations in the timeline and evidence export
detail: Every batch after a correction satisfies norm_at > corrected_ts, and the accumulator is reset to cycle_index+1=1 each restart, so the Gt guard re-fires for every subsequent batch: all post-correction co-nudges/reminders are labeled invitation_sent with empty detail. §8.3's correction flow always produces four post-correction batches (correct_reference_call.sql:32 resets attempt_count = 0), so the exported evidence record silently mislabels sends after every correction.
recommended_fix: Track whether the restart already happened (e.g. a Boolean in the accumulator) so only the FIRST post-correction batch gets cycle_index 0, then 1, 2, 3; add a unit test with 2+ post-correction batches.
